weeks.goal: Learn how websites and WordPress work, and build your first practice site in Elementor.
Finish a second polished WordPress site, then begin Shopify fundamentals.

weeks.theme: Shopify Store Building + Meta Ads Intro
weeks.goal: Complete a full demo Shopify store and start learning paid social on Meta.
Learn to structure, target, and draft real Meta ad campaigns properly.
Master SEO fundamentals and gain real HTML/CSS coding skill to tweak sites.
Create content and designs, build email flows, and read data in GA4 and Search Console.
Shadow the team and ship your first real contributions to agency projects.
Own a landing page, product setup, ad set, and email end-to-end with review.
Build a complete small-business site + funnel and plan your next 30 days.

tasks.title: Map the digital marketing landscape
tasks.detail: Complete modules 1-3 of Google Digital Garage 'Fundamentals of Digital Marketing' and note where web dev, SEO, ads, and content each fit in an agency.

resource.label: Google Digital Garage - Fundamentals of Digital Marketing

tasks.title: Set up your learning workspace
tasks.detail: Create a Google Drive folder 'Afeeda-Learning' with a daily learning log doc, bookmark every course link, and share the log with Nishanth and Rohini.

tasks.title: Learn how websites and WordPress work
tasks.detail: Read WordPress.org's intro docs on domains, hosting, CMS, themes and plugins; write 5 clear notes explaining each in your own words.

tasks.title: Spin up a free WordPress sandbox
tasks.detail: Launch a throwaway site in WordPress Playground (or a free InstaWP site) and explore the admin dashboard end to end.

tasks.title: Take the WordPress beginner lessons
tasks.detail: Work through Learn WordPress beginner lessons on posts vs pages, media library, users and Settings.

tasks.title: Create your first pages and posts
tasks.detail: Add Home, About and Contact pages plus 2 blog posts with images, then set a static homepage. Checkpoint: paste screenshots into your log.

tasks.title: Install Elementor and the Hello theme
tasks.detail: Follow Elementor Academy 'Getting Started' to install Elementor (free) and the Hello Elementor theme on your sandbox.

tasks.title: Learn the Elementor editor
tasks.detail: Watch a beginner Elementor build video and learn sections, containers, columns, widgets and drag-and-drop.

tasks.title: Rebuild your homepage in Elementor
tasks.detail: Recreate your Home page hero and an about section using containers and widgets. Checkpoint: mobile preview looks clean.

tasks.title: Master containers, flexbox and spacing
tasks.detail: Study Elementor Academy lessons on flex containers, padding, margin and gap so layouts behave predictably.

tasks.title: Build a responsive services section
tasks.detail: Create a 3-column services block that stacks neatly on mobile; test the tablet and mobile views.

tasks.title: Set global fonts and colors (brand kit)
tasks.detail: Configure global colors and typography and write 3 lines on why brand consistency matters. Checkpoint: 5-question self-quiz.

tasks.title: Plan Practice Site 1
tasks.detail: Sketch a sitemap (Home, Menu, About, Contact) for a fictional Mysore cafe and collect free images from Pexels.

tasks.title: Build the Home and Menu pages
tasks.detail: Build a hero, featured items and a menu list with prices in INR using Elementor containers.

tasks.title: Add a header and footer
tasks.detail: Create a simple nav header and a footer with contact details and an embedded map (note where Elementor Pro Theme Builder differs from free).

tasks.title: Learn plugins and contact forms
tasks.detail: Install a free forms plugin (Fluent Forms or WPForms Lite) and learn how to install, activate and configure plugins.

tasks.title: Add a contact form, map and WhatsApp chat
tasks.detail: Build a working contact form, embedded Google Map, and a WhatsApp click-to-chat button (handy for Indian small businesses).

tasks.title: Finish and polish Practice Site 1
tasks.detail: Complete About and Contact, fix spacing, and verify mobile. Milestone: Practice Site 1 is complete.

tasks.title: Take the Week 1 self-quiz
tasks.detail: Answer 10 questions on WordPress/Elementor terms (theme, plugin, widget, container, responsive) and log your score.

tasks.title: Show Practice Site 1 to the team
tasks.detail: Walk Nishanth and Rohini through Site 1 and record their feedback in your log.

tasks.title: Consolidate notes and fix weak spots
tasks.detail: Revisit any shaky topic, tidy screenshots and notes into a clean Week 1 summary.

tasks.title: Plan Week 2
tasks.detail: Skim next week's tasks and list any questions for the team.

tasks.title: Learn templates and template kits
tasks.detail: Study Elementor Academy on templates and kits, then import a free starter kit into a fresh site.

tasks.title: Start Practice Site 2
tasks.detail: Plan a small agency website and import a starter kit, restyling it toward an 'Infinity & Beyond' look.

tasks.title: Customize hero and services
tasks.detail: Replace all placeholder content, apply brand colors, and add INR pricing tiers.

tasks.title: Learn tabs, accordions, testimonials, CTA
tasks.detail: Go deep on interactive widgets in Elementor Academy and when to use each.

tasks.title: Build About and Services detail pages
tasks.detail: Use an FAQ accordion and a testimonial carousel on Site 2's inner pages.

tasks.title: Add tasteful animations
tasks.detail: Apply subtle entrance animations and learn why restraint keeps pages professional.

tasks.title: Learn menus and the blog archive
tasks.detail: Set up WordPress navigation menus, categories, and a blog archive layout.

tasks.title: Add a blog with 2 posts
tasks.detail: Create a blog page with featured images and categories on Site 2.

tasks.title: Learn image optimization
tasks.detail: Compress images with TinyPNG, add alt text, and note why page speed matters for SEO and ads.

tasks.title: Finish and polish Practice Site 2
tasks.detail: Complete every page and run a mobile QA pass. Milestone: Practice Site 2 is complete.

tasks.title: Run a basic site QA checklist
tasks.detail: Check broken links, mobile layout, favicon, site title/tagline, and test the contact form.

tasks.title: Peer review with the team
tasks.detail: Give a 15-minute walkthrough of Site 2 and capture feedback to act on.

tasks.title: Learn how Shopify works
tasks.detail: Use Shopify Learn plus Help Center basics to understand hosted ecommerce and how it differs from WordPress.

tasks.title: Start a free Shopify trial store
tasks.detail: Create a trial/development store and explore the admin.

tasks.title: Study store anatomy
tasks.detail: Learn products, collections, pages, navigation, themes and checkout, and note the parts you don't understand yet.

tasks.title: Learn to add products properly
tasks.detail: Study titles, descriptions, images, variants, SKUs, pricing and inventory in Shopify Help.

tasks.title: Add 8-10 demo products
tasks.detail: Build a demo Indian D2C store (e.g. dry fruits or handmade soaps) with prices in INR and a note on GST.

tasks.title: Create collections
tasks.detail: Set up manual and automated collections to organize the catalog.

tasks.title: Customize a free Shopify theme
tasks.detail: Use the Dawn theme editor to build a homepage with hero, featured collection, logo and brand colors.

tasks.title: Add pages, navigation and policies
tasks.detail: Create About, Contact and India-appropriate refund/shipping policy pages plus header and footer menus.

tasks.title: Week 2 review + Shopify self-quiz
tasks.detail: Show the WP sites and store progress to the team and take a 10-question Shopify quiz.

tasks.title: Learn checkout, shipping and payments in India
tasks.detail: Study shipping zones and rates, COD context, and Razorpay/Shopify Payments (learn only, no real payout setup).

tasks.title: Configure shipping and taxes (test)
tasks.detail: Set up domestic shipping zones and a free-shipping threshold, then place a test order in test mode.

tasks.title: Learn discounts and promotions
tasks.detail: Set up a discount code and an automatic discount on the demo store.

tasks.title: Complete the demo store end to end
tasks.detail: Finalize products, collections, pages, navigation, homepage and a discount, then run a full test order. Milestone: demo store complete.

tasks.title: Run the store QA checklist
tasks.detail: Check mobile view, images, prices, policies and test checkout.

tasks.title: Show the store to the team
tasks.detail: Walk the team through the store and capture feedback.

tasks.title: Explore the Shopify App Store
tasks.detail: Learn essential app categories (reviews, upsell, email) and how app bloat hurts speed; list 3 useful, 3 to avoid.

tasks.title: Learn product-page conversion basics
tasks.detail: Study what makes a PDP convert: strong images, trust signals, reviews and a clear CTA.

tasks.title: Improve 3 product pages
tasks.detail: Rewrite descriptions and add trust elements to 3 PDPs on the demo store.

tasks.title: Compare WooCommerce vs Shopify
tasks.detail: Learn the pros, cons and INR cost trade-offs so you can advise agency clients.

tasks.title: Write a client platform recommendation
tasks.detail: Draft a 1-page pick (Shopify vs WooCommerce) for a fictional Mysore boutique, with reasons.

tasks.title: Preview ecommerce SEO basics
tasks.detail: Learn product/collection titles, meta descriptions and image alt for stores.

resource.label: Google Search Central - SEO Starter Guide

tasks.title: Share the recommendation doc
tasks.detail: Get Nishanth's feedback on your platform recommendation.

tasks.title: Learn how paid social works
tasks.detail: Take Meta Blueprint intro courses on how Meta ads work and the available objectives.

tasks.title: Learn Ads Manager account structure
tasks.detail: Understand the Campaign -> Ad Set -> Ad hierarchy and where budget, audience and placements live.

tasks.title: Explore Ads Manager (no spend)
tasks.detail: Tour the Ads Manager interface and identify each level; do not create anything live yet.

tasks.title: Learn to choose the right objective
tasks.detail: Study Awareness, Traffic, Engagement, Leads and Sales and match each to a business goal.

tasks.title: Learn budgets, bidding and schedule
tasks.detail: Understand daily vs lifetime budgets, CBO vs ABO, and realistic INR budgets for small businesses.

tasks.title: Draft a campaign plan
tasks.detail: Write an objective and structure for a fictional Mysore boutique campaign.

tasks.title: Learn core, custom and lookalike audiences
tasks.detail: Study targeting by interests, custom audiences and lookalikes, plus the retargeting concept.

tasks.title: Build saved audiences (draft)
tasks.detail: Create 2-3 saved audience definitions in Ads Manager without publishing anything.

tasks.title: Week 3 review + Meta quiz
tasks.detail: Show the demo store and ad plan to the team and take a 10-question Meta ads quiz.

tasks.title: Learn the Meta Pixel and Conversions API
tasks.detail: Study why tracking matters, standard events and privacy basics.

tasks.title: Walk through a pixel setup concept
tasks.detail: Learn how a pixel goes on a WordPress or Shopify site and how events like Purchase and Lead fire.

tasks.title: Document a pixel setup plan
tasks.detail: Write the step-by-step to add a pixel to a WordPress client site.

tasks.title: Learn ad formats and creative best practice
tasks.detail: Study image, video, carousel and Reels formats plus hooks, copy and CTA principles.

tasks.title: Design 3 ad creatives in Canva
tasks.detail: Create 3 on-brand ad creatives at correct sizes for the boutique.

tasks.title: Write ad copy variations
tasks.detail: Write 3 primary texts and headlines, including one Kannada or Hindi version for the local market.

tasks.title: Assemble a full campaign in Ads Manager (draft)
tasks.detail: Create objective, ad set (audience/budget/placements) and 3 ads, left paused/in draft. Milestone: first full campaign drafted.

tasks.title: Learn placements
tasks.detail: Study Instagram vs Facebook placements and when to use Advantage+ vs manual.

tasks.title: Review the campaign draft with Rohini
tasks.detail: Get feedback on targeting and creative and note changes.

tasks.title: Learn key ad metrics
tasks.detail: Understand CTR, CPC, CPM, CPL, ROAS and frequency, and what 'good' looks like in India.

tasks.title: Learn A/B testing and iteration
tasks.detail: Study testing creatives and audiences, and when to scale or kill an ad.

tasks.title: Build a reporting template
tasks.detail: Create a sheet listing the KPIs to track weekly for a client.

tasks.title: Learn Google Ads basics
tasks.detail: Take a Skillshop intro to Search, Display and Performance Max and how they differ from Meta.

tasks.title: Learn when to use which channel
tasks.detail: Compare Meta vs Google vs organic for small Indian businesses.

tasks.title: Write a channel-mix recommendation
tasks.detail: Draft a 1-pager splitting a sample INR budget across channels for one client.

tasks.title: Learn how search works
tasks.detail: Read Google's SEO Starter Guide on how Google crawls, indexes and ranks.

resource.label: Google Search Central - SEO Starter Guide

tasks.title: Learn on-page SEO basics
tasks.detail: Study titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs and internal links.

resource.label: Google Search Central - SEO Starter Guide

tasks.title: Optimize Practice Site 2 pages
tasks.detail: Rewrite 3 titles, meta descriptions and heading structures on Site 2.

tasks.title: Learn keyword research
tasks.detail: Study search intent and free tools: Google autocomplete, Keyword Planner and AnswerThePublic.

tasks.title: Build a keyword map
tasks.detail: Create 15 keywords for a Mysore service business grouped by intent (informational vs commercial).

tasks.title: Week 4 review + quiz
tasks.detail: Show the campaign draft and SEO edits and take a 10-question ads + SEO quiz.

tasks.title: Learn speed, mobile and indexing
tasks.detail: Study Core Web Vitals, mobile-first indexing and how crawling/indexing work.

tasks.title: Learn sitemaps and robots.txt
tasks.detail: Understand what they do and how a WordPress SEO plugin generates them.

resource.label: Google Search Central - SEO Starter Guide

tasks.title: Install and configure an SEO plugin
tasks.detail: Set up Yoast or Rank Math on Practice Site 2 with titles, meta and an XML sitemap.

tasks.title: Learn local SEO and Google Business Profile
tasks.detail: Study NAP consistency, categories and reviews, and why GBP is vital for Mysore SMBs.

tasks.title: Draft a GBP optimization checklist
tasks.detail: Write a practical checklist to optimize a local client's Business Profile.

tasks.title: On-page SEO recap quiz
tasks.detail: Self-test the SEO terms and rules you learned this week.

tasks.title: Learn HTML fundamentals
tasks.detail: Work through freeCodeCamp/MDN on elements, structure, headings, links, images and lists.

tasks.title: Hand-code a simple page
tasks.detail: Build an HTML page about a Mysore cafe entirely from scratch in a code editor.

tasks.title: Learn semantic HTML and accessibility
tasks.detail: Study header/nav/main/footer and proper alt text.

tasks.title: Learn CSS fundamentals
tasks.detail: Study selectors, colors, the box model, fonts and spacing.

tasks.title: Style your HTML page
tasks.detail: Apply colors, fonts and layout to your hand-coded cafe page.

tasks.title: Learn Flexbox for layout
tasks.detail: Complete freeCodeCamp Flexbox lessons and rebuild a row of cards.

tasks.title: Learn responsive design and media queries
tasks.detail: Study a mobile-first approach and breakpoints.

tasks.title: Make your page responsive
tasks.detail: Add media queries and test on mobile. Milestone: a hand-coded, responsive page.

tasks.title: Add custom CSS in WordPress
tasks.detail: Use custom CSS to tweak a real section on a WordPress site (a genuine agency use case).

tasks.title: Learn how themes use HTML/CSS
tasks.detail: Use browser DevTools to inspect elements and find the CSS classes on a live page.

tasks.title: Tweak a theme with DevTools + CSS
tasks.detail: Change a button style and spacing on the demo store or a WP site using custom CSS.

tasks.title: Learn when to code vs use a builder
tasks.detail: Write 5 lines of judgement on when hand-coding beats a page builder for agency work.

tasks.title: Run a mini technical audit
tasks.detail: Run PageSpeed Insights on Practice Site 2 and list 5 concrete fixes.

tasks.title: Week 5 review with the team
tasks.detail: Show your hand-coded responsive page, SEO plugin setup and audit.

tasks.title: Build an SEO + HTML/CSS cheat-sheet
tasks.detail: Consolidate the week into a one-page reference doc you can reuse.

tasks.title: Learn content strategy and copywriting
tasks.detail: Take HubSpot Academy content/copywriting lessons on value, structure and CTAs.

tasks.title: Write an SEO blog post
tasks.detail: Write a 600-word SEO post for the Mysore cafe using your keyword map.

tasks.title: Learn content for social
tasks.detail: Study post types, hooks and hashtags for Instagram and Facebook.

tasks.title: Learn Canva Design School essentials
tasks.detail: Study brand kit, templates, resizing and exporting in Canva.

tasks.title: Create the agency social kit
tasks.detail: Design 5 branded posts, 1 story and 1 Reel cover for Infinity & Beyond. Milestone: brand social kit delivered.

tasks.title: Design-principles self-check
tasks.detail: Quiz yourself on contrast, alignment and visual hierarchy against your kit.

tasks.title: Learn email marketing basics
tasks.detail: Study list building, segmentation, deliverability and Indian consent norms via HubSpot Academy.

tasks.title: Set up a free Mailchimp account and list
tasks.detail: Create an audience, a signup form and tags.

tasks.title: Design a welcome email
tasks.detail: Build a template and copy for a D2C brand's welcome email.

tasks.title: Learn automations and funnels
tasks.detail: Study welcome series and the abandoned-cart concept.

tasks.title: Build a 3-email welcome automation (draft)
tasks.detail: Create a 3-step welcome flow in Mailchimp; do not send it live.

tasks.title: Write and A/B subject lines
tasks.detail: Write 6 subject lines and predict which win and why.

tasks.title: Learn Google Analytics 4
tasks.detail: Take Google Analytics Academy GA4 lessons on events, key metrics and reports.

tasks.title: Explore a GA4 demo property
tasks.detail: Use Google's GA4 demo account to find users, traffic sources and conversions.

tasks.title: Learn GA4 setup concept
tasks.detail: Understand how to add GA4 to a WordPress or Shopify site.

tasks.title: Learn Google Search Console basics
tasks.detail: Study the performance, indexing and sitemaps reports via Search Console training.

tasks.title: Learn what Google Tag Manager is
tasks.detail: Understand GTM and why agencies use it to manage tags without editing code.

tasks.title: Draft an analytics setup checklist
tasks.detail: Write a checklist to set up GA4 + Search Console + pixel on a new client site.

tasks.title: Build a monthly marketing report template
tasks.detail: Create a Sheet/Slides template covering traffic, ads, leads, top pages and next steps.

tasks.title: Week 6 review with the team
tasks.detail: Show your content, social kit, email flow and analytics work.

tasks.title: Half-way skills self-assessment
tasks.detail: Rate every skill 1-5 and note the biggest gaps to close in the second half.

tasks.title: Study the agency's own brand assets
tasks.detail: Review the current website and brand assets and note improvements you could make.

tasks.detail: Agree 2-3 real deliverables with the team to work on next.

tasks.detail: Build a genuine Services or Portfolio section in Elementor/theme, fully on-brand.
